writtenTo: The people of Edom and Judah
importantNotes: Obadiah is the shortest book in the Old Testament — just 21 verses.
Edom's sin was pride and gloating over Judah's destruction.
The Edomites were descendants of Esau, Jacob's brother — making their betrayal deeply personal.
'The day of the LORD is near for all nations' (v. 15) — judgment extends beyond Edom.
Edom was eventually absorbed into other peoples and disappeared from history.

chapters.1: God pronounces judgment on Edom for their pride and betrayal of Judah; the Day of the LORD is near.
